details.note: M0 SFT REJECTED. Evaluated on the frozen behavioral held-out set (3650 records): call_f1 collapsed from B0's 0.6191 to 0.0046 at step 400 and 0.0000 from step 1200, i.e. the model stops calling tools entirely. Parsing stays valid (1.000), so this is a decision collapse, not a formatting failure. Root cause is the training corpus, not the trainer: only 9 of 55719 trainable records (0.0162%) contain a <tool_call> in their supervised target, because the records that carry tool-call supervision were rejected by the canonical boundary. SFT as configured is harmful and is not promoted.
